# Canonical native snapshot decoder: private source-only candidate

Contributor: Codex rust_implementation, 2026-10-11. This implements a missing value interface, not another validator, kernel, history engine or source-admission decision. It is uncompiled/unexecuted at this freeze. The only target dependency is the unchanged parity_solver crate; root owns any later private link/run gate. Public443, core files, accepted461 recorder and fe2 observer remain unchanged.

`decode_snapshot(context, input)` validates through the EXISTING `source_epoch::selected_view`, which first calls `Context::validate_snapshot`. It returns a private immutable `DecodedSnapshot` borrowing that exact Context. `canonical_snapshot()` reconstructs the live-only encoding on this image. `check_selected_range(context, input, claimed)` checks the complete Copy/Copy/V vector shape and exact selected value of the supplied validated witness. Its result says one native range witness exists, not that the witness is a unique or literal Code-history endpoint.

The actual accepted target is `UnifiedLean.Source.FiniteSourceSnapshot.decodeSnapshot` (4628112b):

| Field | New value operation | Actual source value target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| live | validated sorted original local Copy IDs | same Finset Copy |
| ancestor | bounded local Copy ID at every Copy | same Copy -> Copy function |
| genealogy | Some tree preserved in order; None becomes Leaf(i) | `.some t => t.val`; `.none => .leaf l` |
| location | native Node/Edge/Ancestral retained as distinct tags; None becomes Node(root) | `.some p => p`; `.none => .node root` |
| register | all V entries unchanged, including nonhybrid bits | same V -> Bool function |
| history | explicit `EmptySourceEventHistory`, length0 | `history := []` |

SourceEvent is the existing event datatype (merger, parentPulse, edgeExit, ordinaryEntry, rootEntry) in SourceLabelledForestd6e5b2b5. Empty decoded history does NOT mean the actual source had no prior events, does not reconstruct ages, and is separate from the recorder's entry-plus-prefix Selected vector. No SourceEvent datatype or history recurrence is duplicated here.

The native input domain is the canonical liveSome/deadNone image already required by Context.validate_snapshot, narrower than all typed admitted Snapshot/Code values. The typed decoder can accept SourceValid values with dead garbage or activeNone defaults. This candidate rejects those through the existing validator; it neither changes typed Code nor claims arbitrary-Code coverage. Live trees have bounded local leaves, disjoint leaf fibres, representative ancestry and original-descendant checks from the existing validator. Dead default location is NODE root, never ROOT POPULATION; the latter remains a separate constructor. Ordered grafts/retained representatives are preserved; no minimum-representative or canonical child-order rule is added.

CopyId/VertexId/EdgeId have private constructors and distinct types. Their u8 representation is only a bounded local index: Context already limits Copy<=4 and graph counts<=32, and every construction checks its carrier. These are not proved Lean Fin values or a new scientific size bound. Genealogy uses the existing ordered `forest::Tree` directly; global_labels are preserved in the borrowed Context but never substituted for local Copy leaves or truncated into u8. Parallel E occurrences stay separate even if endpoints coincide.

`original_hybrid_vertex(hid)` returns the original V slot; `original_parent_edge(hid, false/true)` returns incoming[0/1] without reordering. This fixes the true=parent1 convention, whose original probability is Gamma. It does not draw a coin, modify a register, convert old parent0-g or bind a probability bank. The unchanged fit binder performs old-g complement. All original register bits are retained by the decoder; natural/conditional/control behavior remains the word engine's responsibility.

Full selected range uses the SAME validated native projection and existing tree data. Claimed arrays must have exact Copy/Copy/V lengths. Equality is compared to the already bounded expected trees; the candidate does not clone untrusted claimed trees. A claimant can select any valid representative with that view. Selected carries no ancestor/live identity or event history, so checking a cached conditional representative never converts a selected history into a literal Code history. This preserves accepted selected-representative independence as a later coefficient theorem, rather than assuming Selected injectivity.

Bounds: the existing Context count checks run before Source.validate allocations. Existing iterative tree validation bounds recursive clones to at most2*Copy-1 nodes/height<Copy. The new output has exactly Copy genealogy/location/ancestor entries, <=Copy live entries, V bits and one complete selected view. No caller count controls an allocation outside those existing bounds, no BigInt/rational arithmetic, no text parsing or independent resource counter is introduced. There is no UNKNOWN/table protocol here; malformed input/range returns Error, with no partial decoded object exposed. Owned malicious input allocation/destruction remains the caller/parser's responsibility; this API accepts references.

Exact R0 binding STILL REQUIRED: a supplied accepted RootedBinary N and original registry H, with V/E/X/Copy index bijections, source/target/root/leaf/sample fields equal to Context. Native finite graph validation is not a Lean witness, labelled planarity, CutChild, a reconstruction engine or full source admission. All semantic variable axes remain outside this pure value decoder: slot-major native E then A must map to actual `(slot, Option E)` (A to none), hybrid ordinal to the corresponding original V/hybrid. It does not sort any word or date phase. Literal tied-order and Old-cut correspondence remain untouched.

R1 proof target: fieldwise identify this decoded value with typed decodeSnapshot of the corresponding canonical typed Snapshot; use original Leaf/Graft and Node/Edge/RootPopulation constructor maps. Accepted Tree3d862f8d supplies bounded well-labelled tree encoding, Snapshot4628 supplies typed decode/encode and selected preservation, Enumeration6dab supplies view_eq/project, and WholeCausalViewde38 prune_all supplies full-carrier pruning identity. Existing helpers do not prove this NEW Rust translation. Successful future finite tests will be value controls, not universal parser/native/typed refinement.

R2/R3/R4 remain separate: exact native/typed polynomial coefficient identity, DAG full-record induction, physical bank/compiler-order/erased Old observation relation. This decoder does not alter probabilities, public gates, formal theorem completion or the meaning of the prior finite observer5/5 controls. Checked6a842 is only a value-erasure commuting equation. Current connected1581 public acceptance review is root-owned; source pins here refer to exact already checked parent bodies, with no peer native-loader provenance claim.

Expected decoded fields must be literal, not another decoder or encode/decode-only mirror. Root will bind compiler/protected rlibs/linker/argv/output/resource/pins before any run.
